verification_note: Included items were selected only where the Google source presented them as a course, learning path, or public learning series and the learning surface was free to access or covered by Google Skills no-cost access. Coursera certificates and product/tool-only links were intentionally excluded.

courses.title: Make AI Work for You
courses.brief: A Google YouTube learning series showing how Gemini, Gemini Live, and NotebookLM can help with everyday work tasks and productivity.
courses.long_description: This public Google learning series introduces practical ways to use Google AI tools for workplace productivity, including Gemini, Gemini Live, and NotebookLM.

courses.title: AI Boost Bites
courses.brief: Short Google Skills lessons designed to help learners keep up with practical AI skills in under ten minutes per lesson.
courses.long_description: AI Boost Bites is a Google Skills learning path for busy learners who want short, practical AI lessons.

courses.title: AI Literacy for Teens: Experience AI
courses.brief: Free AI and machine learning lessons and classroom materials for teachers and students aged 11 to 14.
courses.long_description: Experience AI provides free lessons, resources, and classroom materials to help young learners understand AI and machine learning responsibly.

courses.title: AI for Students
courses.brief: A Google YouTube series showing students how Gemini can help with studying, research, writing, and understanding difficult subjects.
courses.long_description: This public Google learning series introduces practical student uses of Google Gemini for study, research, writing, and learning support.

courses.title: Gemini and the Software Development Lifecycle
courses.brief: Learn how to use Gemini across software development tasks including development, testing, deployment, and application management.
courses.long_description: This Google Skills course covers practical use of Gemini in the software development lifecycle, from development and testing through deployment and management.

courses.title: Introduction to AI Image Generation
courses.brief: A Google Skills course introducing diffusion models and AI image generation on Google Cloud.
courses.long_description: This course introduces diffusion models behind modern AI image generation and covers how image generation models can be trained and deployed on Vertex AI.

courses.title: Introduction to Large Language Models
courses.brief: A Google Skills course introducing large language models and prompt tuning concepts.
courses.long_description: This course explains what large language models are and introduces prompt tuning as a way to improve LLM performance.
